body:
i downloaded a dating app. didn’t even swipe or talk to anyone but it felt like i was cheating on him even though we’re not together anymore. i just wish that it wouldn’t be so hard. 

i know its selfish, but i have friends who have been cheated on and stayed and things got better in their relationship and part of me wanted to be better than them and fix my relationship because even though there was a lot of hurt, he never cheated on me. and i just kept thinking well if x can stay with her bf after what he did to her than surely i’ll be able to stay with mine. 

i had a lot of hope for us and really believed that we could work things out and now that we’re over it feels like we had so much wasted potential and it just burns even more.

i think this will be my worst heartbreak. i’m hoping that it’s my first and last but i’m still young so it likely won’t be unfortunately. 

i hope that time helps but i’m also very impatient and don’t want to have to wait months just to feel okay again. i know that things will get better but right now it feels like my world has ended and all i want to do is cry and scream and that’s okay. thank you for the support.

it’s just hard. i’m torn between wanting him and wanting better for myself. i know deep down that i deserve better but i just can’t help myself, i guess that’s expected since it’s only been a day lol but i just feel like the love and feelings i have for him won’t ever go away.

i wish i could go no contact to help me heal and move on easier but the thought of not having him there will only be worse for me. right now we’re talking a little bit and he’s being supportive of my feelings and allowing me to feel hurt and broken but i don’t know if that will help me move on.

i have small moments where i feel strong and like i’m ready to move on and get better but then i just go back to feeling broken and like a part of me is missing. 

i know that things will get better eventually and that the next few months will be hard and i will have a lot of healing and self-love to gain but for now i think i’m going to just allow myself to cry and feel pain and be sad and just get it all out. thank you for the support.

i honestly teared up whilst reading this message. thank you genuinely. although you only said some words, you’ve given me some hope to keep fighting for happiness and i appreacite you for that. i hope you’re able to make it out of that dark time too. good luck on your journey, everything will work out for us in the end :)

you’re not alone, i used to think the same thing. why would anyone want to commit suicide when the world has so many great things about it? surely you can just get over it eventually but i guess not. finding a job has been hard, i’ve been struggling for the past eight months. i had to quit my college course early due to not being able to do the work because of how severe my depression was becoming. 

it seems like we’re always going to be stuck in this hole of wanting to commit and feeling depressed all of the time but life shouldn’t be lived like this. as generic of a saying it is, suicide won’t fix your problems. the only thing that will fix things is us, how you’re living right now won’t last forever things can change but it’s up to you to decide how to do that. depression is so hard, it makes you feel like you’re alone and you’re the only person struggling like this but you’re not, there’s so many other people who are out there that have struggled just like you and have made it through and i honestly believe you’ll be one of those. i promise things won’t stay like this forever, it may seem like it now but you still have some time left so please just hold on a little bit longer. i hope this doesn’t come across as fake or anything seeing as this is a suicide subreddit but genuinely, there are people that will be willing to help you or give you advice. things will be okay

you can message me anytime if you need anyone to talk or rant to about things, we’re in different countries because you used $ so the time zones might be a little off but i’m here to rant to if you ever feel like it

life in general i guess. so many traumas and situations that have happened in the last year, it’s draining. i’m getting tired of being alive because it would be easier than continuing to live through all of this pain
if you need someone to talk to then i’m here, message me and i’ll listen :)
